headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.7.1-modder.4
summary: A built-in Explorer tab lets you browse and edit files inside your instances right from the launcher — no root required.

items.text: New Explorer tab in the main navigation: browse files inside any launcher-managed instance, including game data that would otherwise need root to reach.
Open text files in an editor with atomic saves, create folders, rename, copy/cut/paste, delete with confirmation, and export any file to device storage.
Explorer keeps you inside the selected instance with canonical-path checks and hides credential directories from listings and operations.
